materialDefinitionConflicts.conflict: Retail industry−2.4%, accounting domestic/group revenue, household reach/frequency and category leadership are different definitions
materialDefinitionConflicts.resolution: Keep separate issuer/product/geography/period/metric populations; no market-share percent/gain or competitor-rank derivation. Limited conclusion does not depend on reconciling them into a common denominator.

materialDefinitionConflicts.conflict: Own gross margins/operating scale could be mistaken for lowest-cost position or pricing power
materialDefinitionConflicts.resolution: Assess own capability and limitations; peer cost/elasticity N/R, no lowest-cost or unlimited pass-through claim.

materialDefinitionConflicts.conflict: Strong brand/distribution narrative versus Q1 disruption and weakFY2025 domestic growth
materialDefinitionConflicts.resolution: Both retained; evidence supports established capability but not unconstrained/sustainable clear leadership. Channel execution is an explicit threat/invalidation condition.

pricingPower.assessment: Brand/reach and stable own margins support commercial resilience; unlimited price pass-through, measured price premium or elasticity are not established.

qualitativeRubricInterpretation: Competitive position supported with meaningful reach/brand capabilities; sustainable clear-leader interpretation withheld. Descriptive research only, not a formal scoring band or peer league table.
researchConclusion: An established competitive franchise with meaningful brand/distribution capabilities and demonstrated operating scale is supported. Lowest-cost superiority and sustainable clear leadership are not established.
